pages.text: High-level sorcerers have a high status among the illagers, and their strength is not to be underestimated. Perhaps you can train sorcerer servants who will follow your commands through a grimoire that combines materials from multiple schools.
Sorcerer servants will fight for you using powerful magic, and you can also trade with them using emeralds.
The higher their level, the richer their wares become: magic cores, magic fabrics, grimoires, totems of undying, and even forbidden relics. A bed is required for them to restock in peace.
